plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Eltek SmartPack / WebPower DC power systems (ELTEK-DISTRIBUTED-MIB, enterprise PEN 12148). It reports uptime, battery voltage and temperature, rectifier status, output voltage, output current and inlet temperature, and interface traffic.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: battery_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Measured battery voltage of the Eltek DC power system in volts, from batteryVoltage (ELTEK-DISTRIBUTED-MIB, 1.3.6.1.4.1.12148.9.3.2.0, 1/100 V units, divided by 100). A raw value of 0 is dropped.

metrics.name: battery_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Highest enabled battery temperature measurement of the Eltek DC power system in degrees Celsius, from batteryTemp (1.3.6.1.4.1.12148.9.3.4.0). The controller reports Celsius or Fahrenheit depending on its global setting; select the matching temperature unit when adding the instance and Fahrenheit readings are converted.

metrics.name: rectifier_output_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Output voltage of each present rectifier in volts, from rectifierStatusOutputVoltage (1.3.6.1.4.1.12148.9.5.5.2.1.4, 1/100 V units, divided by 100).

metrics.name: rectifier_output_current_amps
metrics.description: Output current of each present rectifier in amperes, from rectifierStatusOutputCurrent (1.3.6.1.4.1.12148.9.5.5.2.1.3, deciamperes, divided by 10).

metrics.name: rectifier_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Input air temperature of each present rectifier in degrees Celsius, from rectifierStatusTemp (1.3.6.1.4.1.12148.9.5.5.2.1.5), converted from Fahrenheit when the Fahrenheit unit is selected.

metrics.name: rectifier_state
metrics.description: Operational status of each rectifier from rectifierStatusStatus (1.3.6.1.4.1.12148.9.5.5.2.1.2): normal maps to 1 and alarm maps to 2. Rows reporting notPresent, notUsed or disabled are skipped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
